name: open
description: Whether the dialog is open. Required — Dialog is always controlled.

name: onOpenChange
description: Callback fired when the open state changes (e.g. overlay click, Escape, close button).

name: onClose
description: Callback fired specifically when the dialog closes (after `onOpenChange(false)`).

name: size
description: Maximum width of the dialog. 'small' suits simple confirmation dialogs; 'medium' fits general forms or information; 'large' suits complex forms or detailed content; 'xlarge' suits dialogs with a lot of content; 'full' is a full-screen dialog. Default: 'medium'.

name: rounded
description: Corner radius of the dialog (small, medium, large). Default: 'medium'.

name: title
description: Dialog title, rendered as the accessible name.

name: description
description: Dialog description text, rendered below the title.

name: actions
description: Action buttons rendered in the footer. For irreversible actions (delete, reset), include a 'danger' intent action and set `closeOnOverlayClick: false` so the confirmation can't be dismissed accidentally. Takes precedence over `footer` when both are provided.

name: footer
description: Custom footer content, used instead of `actions` for non-button footers.

name: showCloseButton
description: Whether to show the close (X) button in the header. Default: true.

name: closeOnOverlayClick
description: Whether clicking the overlay closes the dialog. Set to `false` for confirmation dialogs on irreversible actions, or when the dialog contains a form, to prevent users from accidentally losing their input or bypassing a decision. Default: true.

name: closeOnEscape
description: Whether pressing Escape closes the dialog. Default: true.
